description: Header file defining the DU cell manager class and related data structures for managing DU cells in a radio network.

classes.name: du_cell_manager
classes.description: Class managing DU cells, including adding, starting, stopping, and reconfiguring cells.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new DU cell with specified configuration.

methods.name: get_cell_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specified cell.

methods.name: stop_accepting_ues
methods.description: Stops accepting new user equipment in a specified cell.

methods.name: handle_cell_reconf_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for a DU cell.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a specific DU cell asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a specific DU cell asynchronously.
